C = saveFor 1: a town puts the price of a hall, or of what a hall needs, aside when only gold is missing, and sells surplus resources when that pays for it today (in the user's game the Castle was the best building from day 9 to day 36 and never built - no Capitol, 2,000 gold a day against his 4,000, creatures for 24,425 gold unbought when the capital fell; in 16 probe games to day 45 the Capitol stands on day 12 to 19 instead of day 13 to 36, total army 246,000 against 227,000). L = battlePlan 3: the combat AI judges every action under four plans for our side (advance, hold, lie in wait, close ranks around the shooter) - guard benchmark, 579 battles, paired: 0.9 +- 0.7 points of the army lost less (6.2 % instead of 7.1 % against guards of 30 % of our strength, 17.1 % instead of 19.1 % at 50 %). U = muster 1 + supplyDays 8: the main hero fetches a big stock from a town beyond the four days it looks ahead, couriers run up to eight days. R = secondArmy 1 with secondArmyEdge 0.6.
